final: SELECT zoneref, traitcount, 1.0 * traitcount / SUM(traitcount) OVER () AS share, 1.0 * traitcount / SUM(traitcount) OVER () - 1.0 / COUNT(traitcount) OVER () AS margin_above_average FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL AND 1.0 * traitcount / SUM(traitcount) OVER () > 1.0 / COUNT(traitcount) OVER () ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
